attributes.action: Legalisation of electric bikes and scooters for people with helmets
attributes.additional_details: Individual People are starting to crave the fact that there are cheaper ways of mobility, but they are to scared of the police because in the uk police may give you a fine and more, such as points on the person's license and they will confiscated the property of the person ( electric scooter & bike ). And I want to make riding a e-bike or e-scooter more safer by making riders wear helmets and more safer stuff to make get to there places on time
attributes.background: The reason why I would like people to sign this petition is because there are people who can’t afford an automobile such as a car because of the fact that insurance is to expensive,& quite often I have realised that there a lot of people who ride electric bikes scooters but they are scared of police
